user_intent: Run the final verification phase for the ClickUp 4.0 carousel: kill stray dev servers, typecheck/build, and visually verify all four demo slides against reference PNGs.
resolution: Killed stray dev servers by PID, confirmed the reported ~68 TS errors were stale (typecheck/build clean), then wrote a reusable Playwright script (scripts/cu4-visual-check.mjs) that clicks each carousel tab via JS dispatch (avoiding hover auto-pause), captures early/late/reduced-motion states, and compares against reference PNGs. Bypassed the cookie-gated /work route by temporarily removing '/work' from PROTECTED_PREFIXES in src/config/auth.ts and restoring it afterward. Found and fixed one real bug: the Tasks demo Icon helper set both inset and width/height:100%, making disclosure carets render oversized; fixed with inset:0 + margin:auto centering at intrinsic SVG size.
